acceptance: A new question or access row finds its use case by the use case ID in its use_case cell, imported from the one tracker-tables useCaseId helper with no private copy, so two vendors' same-named use cases are never matched to each other's row. (B5, B8)
A new use case takes its use_case_name from the proposed field, and an ID that differs from its use_case cell or duplicates a workbook or earlier row stops the run. (B8)
An unknown use case ID, or a use_case cell in the name or slug-alone form, stops the run naming file and line, with nothing written. (B10)

contract.md holds the merged use case ID matching text, every test fixture uses IDs and the new local reference keys, and the component's tests, the coverage check and the repeat byte-identity test pass. (B5, B8, B10)
